mathPatches.name: supertrend
mathPatches.description: BTH-Script v2 Native Supertrend Engine with NaN Guard
mathPatches.code: function(factor, atrPeriod) { const len = close.length; const supertrend = new Array(len).fill(NaN); const direction = new Array(len).fill(1); const atr = ta.atr(atrPeriod || 10); const upperBand = new Array(len).fill(0); const lowerBand = new Array(len).fill(0); let startIdx = 0; while (startIdx < len && (isNaN(atr[startIdx]) || atr[startIdx] === undefined)) { startIdx++; } if (startIdx >= len) { const res = [supertrend, direction]; res.supertrend = supertrend; res.direction = direction; return res; } for (let i = startIdx; i < len; i++) { const hl2 = (high[i] + low[i]) / 2; const basicUpper = hl2 + (factor || 3) * atr[i]; const basicLower = hl2 - (factor || 3) * atr[i]; if (i === startIdx) { upperBand[i] = basicUpper; lowerBand[i] = basicLower; direction[i] = 1; supertrend[i] = lowerBand[i]; continue; } upperBand[i] = (basicUpper < upperBand[i - 1] || close[i - 1] > upperBand[i - 1]) ? basicUpper : upperBand[i - 1]; lowerBand[i] = (basicLower > lowerBand[i - 1] || close[i - 1] < lowerBand[i - 1]) ? basicLower : lowerBand[i - 1]; let dir = direction[i - 1]; if (dir === 1 && close[i] < lowerBand[i]) { dir = -1; } else if (dir === -1 && close[i] > upperBand[i]) { dir = 1; } direction[i] = dir; supertrend[i] = dir === 1 ? lowerBand[i] : upperBand[i]; } const res = [supertrend, direction]; res.supertrend = supertrend; res.direction = direction; return res; }
